VERDICT: REPLICATED
CONFIDENCE: high
ONE_LINE: Core CDKM adder constructions and the optimized resource/depth claims were independently reimplemented and exhaustively validated across multiple n with exact formula matches.
KEY_STRENGTH: Exhaustive basis-state testing plus superposition/statevector checks and exact gate-count/depth agreement for n=4,6,8 provide strong end-to-end confirmation.
KEY_LIMITATION: VBE comparison and the paper’s extension circuits (mod-2^n, incoming carry, comparator) were not fully reimplemented/verified.
